frozen_v4_protocol_constants.course_endpoint: EC and signed error; course-class Macro-F1 not a primary endpoint
frozen_v4_protocol_constants.mu_fit_population: one row per retained labeled train enrollment

measurement_scope: Descriptive data audit; no fit, sentiment inference or model evaluation

reference.scope: All distinct courses in the frozen train cohort; includes P1-P4 and FULL_A without multiplicity

spec.grain: One row per course_id; subgroup constant across all phases and enrollments of a course
spec.normalization: Cast course_id/teacher_id to string, trim surrounding spaces; discard NULL/empty teacher_id; deduplicate (course_id,teacher_id); restrict to bundle courses
spec.profile_requirement: None; teacher relation IDs remain valid when entities/teacher has no matching profile

count_definitions.n_teachers: Distinct usable teacher IDs for the course
count_definitions.n_seen_teachers: Intersection with the frozen train teacher ID reference
count_definitions.n_new_teachers: Course teacher IDs outside the frozen train reference

spec.missing_meaning: No usable teacher ID in the relation mapping; does not establish that the course has no teachers
spec.temporal_scope: Final relationship snapshot at collection; no per-edge as-of history; retrospective analysis metadata, not an online feature
spec.interpretation: A relation to train teachers, independent of learner subgroup and categorical codes; no target values used
